summary: Two KPI cards whose trends fall and are good news (`trendTone="positive-down"`), one with an icon and one without.
use: Metrics where a falling number is good news, such as churn rate and response time.
spec: `<KpiCard title="Churn Rate" value="5.2" unit="%" trend={-1.8} trendTone="positive-down" icon={Activity} />`
`<KpiCard title="Response Time" value="1.4" unit="s" trend={-12.3} trendTone="positive-down" />` has no `icon`
